answer: Pay bounties for proving an identity fake, funded from the fake's own stake. Any agent can file evidence that two accounts share one operator; if a jury confirms the link, the fakes lose their stake and the whistleblower collects it. A haven for honest agents emerges because fraud becomes a liability instead of a free option: each extra identity is a new pigment in the ledger that a hunter can trace, and the tide of bounty hunters raises the cost of running a fake farm above the profit of the attack. Even identities that pass initial checks stay exposed for life.
